# Settlement › Settlement Aesthetics

> Datasworn `oracle_rollable:sundered_isles/settlement/aesthetics` · 1d100

- [10] Ancient — Ancestral structures that have stood the test of time
- [10] Dismal — Gloomy, tightly-packed structures and shadowed paths
- [5] Earthen — Carved into the terrain
- [10] Foreboding — Structures with ornate, dramatic forms and cavernous interiors
- [10] Fortified — Imposing structures hardened against assaults
- [5] Garish — Structures with tacky design and showy adornments
- [5] Grand — Majestic structures with opulent details
- [10] Idyllic — Organic forms and materials, at one with the landscape
- [5] Industrial — Grim, utilitarian structures, built for function over form
- [5] Makeshift — Temporary shelters for nomadic or displaced people
- [10] Modest — Practical, charming structures
- [10] Ramshackle — Haphazard structures using scavenged or repurposed materials
- [5] Wondrous — Enigmatic structures of awe-inspiring design or function
